Answer: B
Reason: The provided axial CT image demonstrates a cystic lesion with an air-fluid level in the left lower lobe (indicated by arrows), which is the classic radiographic appearance of an infected intralobar pulmonary sequestration. This finding corresponds to option B, as sequestrations most commonly occur in the left lower lobe and present as opacities or cysts that may contain air-fluid levels when infected.
